target.nextApplicableTask: next publication receipt containing more than one artifact identity

increment.classification: Candidate partial / real correction replay verified
increment.rule: Validate artifactRole, canonicalPath, mediaType, producerStep, bytes and digest as one atomic descriptor entry; never satisfy scalar fields from different objects.

minimumTrial: Generate one immutable evidence manifest with one descriptor per artifact.
Have FINAL_CLAIM_RECEIPT reference a descriptor entry rather than restating loose size/digest fields.
Reject cross-entry scalar matches with HOLD_SUBJECT_DESCRIPTOR_MISMATCH.
Render the human summary from the verified descriptor.
Obtain an independent verifier receipt before wider adoption.
